The webservices module calls `saveVisit` in four main or test files at five sites. The main-code callers are `VisitResource1_9.save` and the save and delete paths of `VisitAttributeResource1_9`. The rest are tests. I could not search `openmrs-core`, so I have not checked what the method does there.

1. **`VisitResource1_9.save(Visit)`** is the primary caller. It is the REST save hook for visits, so any change in `saveVisit` affects visit create and update requests. `omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/VisitResource1_9.java:251-254` (`github.com/openmrs/openmrs-module-webservices.rest`).
2. **`VisitAttributeResource1_9.save(VisitAttribute)`** calls `saveVisit` on the parent visit after attaching or adding the attribute (line 114). Attribute create and update requests depend on it. `omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/VisitAttributeResource1_9.java:96-116`.
3. **`VisitAttributeResource1_9.delete(VisitAttribute, String, RequestContext)`** voids an attribute and then calls `saveVisit` (line 126), so attribute deletion depends on it too. `omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/VisitAttributeResource1_9.java:122-127`.
4. **`VisitController1_9Test.shouldRemoveAnEncounterFromAnExistingVisitOnEdit`** is a test that calls `saveVisit` directly (line 277) to set up data. It would break if `saveVisit` stopped persisting the encounter list. `omod/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs1_9/VisitController1_9Test.java:271-286`.
5. **`EncounterController1_9Test.createEncounter_shouldEditVisitPropertyForAnExisitingEncounter`** is a test that calls `saveVisit` directly (line 359) to create the visit it links to. `omod/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs1_9/EncounterController1_9Test.java:353-369`.

The search only matched the literal name `saveVisit`. Code that reaches `saveVisit` indirectly, for example through a generic save or cascade, would not appear here. The method end line for item 5 is inferred from the 369 I read, so it may be a line or two off.
